root_cause_label: Agent assumed optimized query was functionally equivalent without verifying against original output, because the original query always timed out before producing output
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent wrote a correct-looking CTE-based optimization but could not verify exact equivalence because the original query always timed out, and the harness ultimately rejected the submission as not equivalent.
t_err_evidence: Step 8: Agent writes /app/sol.sql based on assumed functional equivalence. It never established a reference output from the original query (which timed out in steps 4-7), so the solution is committed under the false premise that the new query is provably equivalent.
t_commit_evidence: Step 19: Agent includes task_complete=true for the first time, submitting the solution to the harness for grading. After this point no further changes were made to sol.sql.
trigger_explanation: The agent assumed its rewritten query using CTEs and ROW_NUMBER() was functionally identical to the original correlated-subquery version. It could not verify this assumption because the original query consistently timed out before producing any output. The manual spot-check in step 21 (verifying only the top synset for word 'break') was insufficient to confirm full equivalence across all 500 rows.
forewarning_evidence: Steps 11-15: The original query produces zero output even with 30-second and 60-second timeouts, meaning the agent had no reference output to compare against. The agent noted this but proceeded without finding an alternative verification strategy.
